how_to_fill: Copy this file to AUTHORITY_B1.json in the controller folder. Fill every <<FILL>>. Then set status to ADMITTED.
The launcher refuses any record whose status is not ADMITTED, and any blank that is still a <<FILL>> text.
Run 'aws_control.py hashes' to print the hashes and the ledger numbers this record needs. It calls no AWS service and writes nothing.
The price receipt is valid for 60 minutes. Fill this record and launch inside that time.
This record grants nothing by itself. controller_common.authority() checks every field against the files on disk.

job_record.source: The sealed Option B package: source.zip (plan 08_OPTION_B_PLAN_v1_0.md, seal chain optionb/SEAL_OPTIONB.jsonl) and the seven pinned files of model B, Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775.
job_record.purpose: Option B usefulness test, GPU job b1: Gate 0 self-test, practice calls, practice gates, final calls only if every gate passes, then scoring. One outcome code from a program.
job_record.instance: one g5.2xlarge (one A10G 24 GB GPU), image ami-0dddfa1ffa6b87af7, region us-west-2
job_record.limits: cap 5.00 USD all services; hard time limit 180 minutes; one attempt; no retry; at most 5,000 model calls; result archive at most 100,000,000 bytes; the host shuts itself down
job_record.clock_minutes_after_launch: setup must end 30; all model work stops 135; forced shutdown 175; hard limit 180
job_record.cleanup: aws_control.py ends the host, deletes its disk, downloads and re-opens the result archive, then empties the four storage keys and writes CLEANUP.json. independent_cleanup.py is then run by the operator within 30 minutes, and before minute 180 after launch.
